description.value:
You descend from kitsune who possessed such compelling powers of persuasion that they could walk into a palace at sunrise and end up as the power behind the throne by nightfall. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Nudging Whisper] action.

Your alternate form is a common Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human) called a tailless form.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide
